title: Finite fibre-rank profiles give a finite upper-rank open and closed rank equations
statement: Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme, meaning quasi-compact and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]. Let $(F_d)_{d\geq0}$ be coherent $\mathcal O_S$-modules [pqf-def-coherent]. Fix $m\geq0$ and integers $r_d\geq0$ for $d\geq m$. With residue fields [def-weil-residue-field], put $h_s(d)=\dim_{\kappa(s)}(F_{d,s}\otimes_{\mathcal O_{S,s}}\kappa(s))$. Assume there is a finite set $H\subseteq\mathbf N^{\mathbf N}$ containing every $h_s$. For $d\geq m$ put $W_d=\{s:h_s(d)\leq r_d\}$. For each $h\in H$ with $h(d)>r_d$ for some $d\geq m$, choose one such degree $e_h$. Then each $W_d$ is open and the finite intersection $V=\bigcap_hW_{e_h}$ satisfies $V=\bigcap_{d\geq m}W_d$; if there are no such $h$, $V=S$. The open scheme $V$ is Noetherian and every $F_d|_V$ is coherent. For every $d\geq m$ there is a quasi-coherent ideal $\mathcal I_d\subseteq\mathcal O_V$ defining a closed immersion $C_d\hookrightarrow V$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], such that for every scheme $T$ and map $t:T\to V$, $t^*(F_d|_V)$ is locally free of rank $r_d$ if and only if $t$ factors uniquely through $C_d$. Here pullback is ordinary module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], and locally free of rank $r$ means locally isomorphic to $\mathcal O_T^{\oplus r}$. Moreover any $g:T\to S$ for which every $g^*F_d$ is locally free of rank $r_d$ for $d\geq m$ factors uniquely through $V$. No Noetherian hypothesis on $T$ or flatness hypothesis on any $F_d$ is imposed.

source.place: Bourbaki Expose 221, Lemma 3.5 and its use of Lemma 3.6, printed pp.263--264; finite-profile expansion of the stationary upper-rank opens. Also Stacks divisors.tex, Tag 05P8, lemma-locally-free-rank-r-pullback (2),(3). Archival PDF WANTED; primary scan read online.

proof.text: For each $d\geq m$, apply [lem-sfb-coherent-universal-rank-locus] to the Noetherian scheme $S$, the coherent module $F_d$, and the nonnegative integer $r_d$. Its bounded-fibre-dimension open is exactly $W_d$ by the definition of $h_s(d)$, so every $W_d$ is open.

source.place: Tag 05P8, lemma-locally-free-rank-r-pullback (2),(3); finite-profile argument formulated by Q57, following Bourbaki Expose 221 Lemma 3.5, printed pp.263--264 (primary scan read online).

proof.text: Let $B=\{h\in H:\exists d\geq m,\ h(d)>r_d\}$. It is finite, so $V=\bigcap_{h\in B}W_{e_h}$ is open. Membership in every $W_d$ implies membership in $V$. Conversely, if $s\in V$ violated a bound at degree $d\geq m$, then $h_s\in H$ would belong to $B$. Its chosen witness would give $h_s(e_{h_s})>r_{e_{h_s}}$, contradicting $s\in W_{e_{h_s}}$. Thus $V=\bigcap_{d\geq m}W_d$. When $B$ is empty the empty intersection is $S$, and the same argument says all bounds hold everywhere.

source.place: Tag 05P8, lemma-locally-free-rank-r-pullback (2),(3); finite-profile argument formulated by Q57, following Bourbaki Expose 221 Lemma 3.5, printed pp.263--264 (primary scan read online).

proof.text: Write $j:V\hookrightarrow S$. Apply [lem-sfb-noetherian-open-closed-finite-presentation] with this open immersion and the identity closed immersion $V\to V$. It makes $V$ locally Noetherian and $j$ quasi-compact. Choose a finite affine open cover of $S$; the inverse images under $j$ are quasi-compact and cover $V$, so their finite union is quasi-compact. Hence $V$ is Noetherian. Every $F_d|_V$ is coherent directly from [pqf-def-coherent]: finite generators near a point restrict to the intersection with $V$, and a map from a finite free module on an open of $V$ is the identical map on that open of $S$, with the same finite-type kernel.

Fix $d\geq m$. Restriction to an open does not change the local ring, residue field, or module stalk at any of its points. Thus every fibre dimension of $E_d=F_d|_V$ is at most $r_d$, by Step 2. Apply [lem-sfb-coherent-universal-rank-locus] on the Noetherian scheme $V$ to the coherent module $E_d$. Its bounded-generator open is all of $V$, so its final clause gives a closed immersion $C_d\hookrightarrow V$ with a quasi-coherent defining ideal $\mathcal I_d$. Its universal property says, for every scheme $T$ and $t:T\to V$, that $t^*E_d$ is locally free of rank $r_d$ exactly when $t$ factors uniquely through $C_d$. There is no condition on $T$ in that cited statement.

source.place: Tag 05P8, lemma-locally-free-rank-r-pullback (2),(3); finite-profile argument formulated by Q57, following Bourbaki Expose 221 Lemma 3.5, printed pp.263--264 (primary scan read online).

proof.text: Finally suppose $g:T\to S$ has all the required locally free pullbacks. For each $d\geq m$, [lem-sfb-coherent-universal-rank-locus] on $S$ factors $g$ through its rank locus $C_{r_d}(F_d)$, hence through $W_d$. In particular its pointwise image lies in every $W_{e_h}$ and therefore in $V$. The factorization through this open is explicit: keep the continuous map with codomain restricted to $V$ and restrict $g^\sharp$ to the opens contained in $V$. This is a morphism of locally ringed spaces because its stalk maps are those of $g$; it is unique since the open inclusion is the inclusion on points and its structure sheaf is the restriction [def-weil-open-immersion]. This also covers empty $T$ and the case $V=S$.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q57-15d0c6bb3 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item in full. The delivery adds a 5-step proof and keeps the statement and stmt_deps unchanged. There are no new nodes and no re-split note. S1: W_d=W_{r_d}(F_d) is open by the first clause of lem-sfb-coherent-universal-rank-locus, whose hypotheses are the item's. S2: elementary finite bad-profile argument giving V=∩_{d≥m}W_d, including B empty ⇒ V=S. S3: V is locally Noetherian and j is quasi-compact by lem-sfb-noetherian-open-closed-finite-presentation, and the preimages of a finite affine cover make V quasi-compact. F_d|_V is coherent directly from pqf-def-coherent. S4: stalks and fibre dimensions are unchanged on V, so W_{r_d}(E_d)=V and the cited node gives C_d↪V with the universal property for arbitrary T. S5: the cited node on S gives g(T)⊆∩W_d=V, and the factorization through the open subscheme is written out (def-weil-open-immersion). I read Stacks divisors.tex lemma-locally-free-rank-r-pullback (05P8), lines 1384-1422: it holds for every T. Edge cases checked: S or T empty; F=0 with r>0; k[ε]/ε² with F=A/ε, where C_1=Spec k, so the universal property is not reduced to fibre dimensions. Duplicate search found only the parent lem-sfb-graded-tail-rank-stratum, which is not a duplicate. No SGA reference. Batch-5: lem-trf-fitting-ideal-generate-locally (Fitting ideals represent local generation by ≤r sections, Stacks 0C3F/07ZC) is general scheme theory placed in the trace-formula chapter only by location. It is neither given by the trace formula or Poincaré duality nor a step of their proofs, so the citation is acceptable. No fixes.
